title: supervise-result
description: What `orch conduct supervise --json` prints for one pass: the actions of the supervisor (each is a records/v1 supervisor-action line of <run>/supervisor.jsonl), or busy when another supervisor of the project holds <runs root>/supervisor.lock.

busy.description: True when another supervisor holds the project; nothing was done.

recover.description: The effective policy of the pass.

actions.description: The actions of the pass, in order; empty when every run was healthy or already reported.
